purpose: Build one immutable Railway context snapshot per protected turn_id, then serve only small scene-needed semantic chunks from it.

pipeline.name: preflight
pipeline.description: Return active state, current calendar beat, last scene summary, immediate constraints. No full cards.

pipeline.name: turn_contract_snapshot
pipeline.description: getTurnContract validates the pending turn_id, selects full-card characters and freezes one server-side context snapshot.

pipeline.name: required_context_manifest
pipeline.description: Railway returns the ordered semantic chunk manifest from the frozen snapshot.

pipeline.name: ordered_context_chunks
pipeline.description: Railway serves each approved chunk in numeric order and records progress; repeats are idempotent and skipped indices are rejected.

pipeline.name: internal_scene_draft
pipeline.description: After all chunks are served, GPT drafts from that snapshot only and does not show the scene yet.

pipeline.name: apply_turn_result
pipeline.description: GPT sends the same turn_id, final scene and proposed_updates; API requires completed context progress, atomically persists state, then authorizes visible output.

hard_rules: Do not return full YAML cards to Custom GPT Actions by default.
There is exactly one immutable context snapshot for one pending turn_id.
Client-returned turn_contract, state slices and chunk lists are never a source of truth.
Do not split raw huge cards into chunks; derive bounded semantic writer-card blocks instead.
POV full-card sources are mandatory; never insert Akira as a protagonist fallback.
Every active NPC writer card includes goal, voice/behavior, reaction triggers, known facts and active unknowns.
applyTurnResult is blocked until every required snapshot chunk was served in order.
State active slice is always needed, but full state history is not.
Location basic slice is needed for every scene.
Schedule slice is needed for base/public/location movement scenes; schedule files may be empty placeholders until filled.
Character full cards remain authoritative in repo; context slices are derived from full cards, not from separate runtime summaries.
Railway may deny a requested block if calendar, location, knowledge, energy, or past triggers do not allow it.
